conclusion.reason: Both substantive, evidence-backed experiments are complete and evaluated under the fixed contract (3/3 candidates used). Result: a tie at the ceiling (mean 1.0, preserved 1, 0 failures) for the baseline, the composed toolkit candidate (985911109), and the task-profile fix candidate (8ad756a8). The champion stays the baseline, since no accuracy improvement was observable at the ceiling. Positive evidence: after reading the trace of 985911109 (the first shipped version of the toolkit), we found its tool family was badly limited, because reads outside /workspace were rejected, relative paths failed, and LibreOffice launched without an isolated profile. That evidence led to 8ad756a8, and under the native profile its first call (workbook_inspect on /input/source.xlsx) succeeded. The run then used the whole tool family (inspect, labels, formula write, recalc) and produced the correct formulas and values. Cost went from about 6/5576/12301 (steps/input tokens/ms per operating-plan run) to about 5/7116/10289 (fewer steps, slightly more input tokens because tool schemas are richer, faster wall clock). Limitations: (1) all tasks were already at 100% accuracy, so accuracy cannot discriminate between bundles here; (2) the suite exercises only one family per task, so we cannot infer transfer to other spreadsheet work, such as multi-sheet, formatting or text tasks; (3) corrections were driven by observing that earlier version; the improvement shown for 8ad756a8 is based on traces, not an independent correctness score; (4) the native probe environment has no /input mount, so /input access was verified from the task trace, not from a probe.

specification.name: spreadsheet-independent-validation
specification.objective: Improve the general spreadsheet capability bundle from actual task evidence. Conduct at least one substantive, evidence-backed plugin experiment, including implementation or composition changes; test the resulting candidate under the fixed task contract. Do not insert case-specific answers. Correctness is primary; report preservation and cost separately. A tie is a legitimate negative result, never a reason to modify the evaluator.

tasks.prompt: Complete /input/source.xlsx using Excel formulas. For every displayed year, normalize reported results by removing non-recurring expenses and gains. Begin with reported tax expense; each adjustment tax rate applies only to its own adjustment. Fill all four normalized metric rows for all years. Preserve all original inputs, labels, units and intentional blanks. Read original comments. Deliver /workspace/result.xlsx; an independent engine recalculates formulas. Python openpyxl and LibreOffice are installed.

Complete /input/source.xlsx using Excel formulas. Fill each segment revenue, gross profit and margin. Fill total units, revenue, gross profit and the portfolio margin. Total price and total cost per unit cells are intentionally blank; do not fill them. Preserve all original inputs, labels, units and intentional blanks. Read original comments. Deliver /workspace/result.xlsx; an independent engine recalculates formulas. Python openpyxl and LibreOffice are installed.

Complete /input/source.xlsx using Excel formulas. Build the four-year debt schedule. Repay equal principal installments each year, based on original principal. Interest uses the same-year opening balance and rate. Fill all five schedule rows for every year. Preserve all original inputs, labels, units and intentional blanks. Read original comments. Deliver /workspace/result.xlsx; an independent engine recalculates formulas. Python openpyxl and LibreOffice are installed.

Complete /input/source.xlsx using Excel formulas. Use the requested case to fill all forecast revenues and EBITDA. Then calculate exit enterprise and equity value in the final year only. Earlier-year exit value cells are intentionally blank. Preserve all original inputs, labels, units and intentional blanks. Read original comments. Deliver /workspace/result.xlsx; an independent engine recalculates formulas. Python openpyxl and LibreOffice are installed.
